## Security review status

A full soundness/audit-surface review of the vendored prover (M31 field module,
FRI, channels, constraint framework, LogUp) is **pending** and is tracked by the
security-review gate (#79) and the RFC-0015 open question on audit granularity.
`REVISION.audited_by` is therefore `pending (area:security)`. This initial
vendoring records provenance and integrity (`tree_sha256`); it does not assert a
completed security sign-off. The differential `diff_upstream_audit_surface_on_bump`
gate applies to future revision bumps, against this pristine baseline.
